dedupe_keys.name: airesq real world thermal search and rescue benchmark

description: The AIResQ team publishes a separate benchmark of 1,988 thermal drone images captured during actual search-and-rescue operations. The current Zenodo record states 640 by 512 pixel images and corresponding person-detection labels in one ZIP archive. It is publicly accessible without charge under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is a sample of real rescue imagery, not the larger AIResQ high-resolution collection or every terrain and weather condition. The benchmark can test automated person detection before modelling search-team coverage or response time in emergency-service scenarios. A caveat is that detector accuracy on these images does not alone show improvement in field rescue outcomes. Image-level splits and target sizes require inspection before comparing algorithms, and the provider does not publish response-operation logs in this deposit. Own metadata and manifest were read without downloading imagery or rerunning detection. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
